strings.zh: 马志士『果然,我猜你一定会来这里的。{SCROLL}你跟刚刚来挑战的那个少年,{NEWLINE}在我们枯叶市的工地冲突中{CLEAR}都表现得非常勇敢。{CLEAR}不过要做大事光有勇气可不行,{CLEAR}让我看看你的实力{CLEAR}是否也能配上我的橙色徽章吧！{SCROLL}

I knew{NEWLINE}you’d show up here.{SCROLL}You and that boy who challenged me{NEWLINE}earlier both showed real guts in the{CLEAR}construction site clash.{SCROLL}But guts alone won’t get the big jobs{NEWLINE}done, kid.{SCROLL}Let’s see if your strength is worthy of{NEWLINE}my Thunder Badge too!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 马志士『你应该是在四处旅行锻炼吧？{NEWLINE}那样的话缺少情报可不行。{CLEAR}把这个装到你的手机上试试。

strings.zh: 马志士『我说你啊！{NEWLINE}还在四处旅行锻炼自己吗？{CLEAR}旅途中肯定遇到不少挫折和选择吧,{CLEAR}只要你能保持心中的正义和勇气{CLEAR}就没有什么好怕的了！
strings.en: Lt. Surge: Hey, you! Still traveling{NEWLINE}around to toughen yourself up?{SCROLL}You’re bound to hit plenty of setbacks{NEWLINE}and tough choices on the road.{SCROLL}But as long as you keep justice and{NEWLINE}courage in your heart, there’s nothing{CLEAR}to be afraid of!

strings.zh: 你好！{NEWLINE}未来的传说！{CLEAR}我都听说了哦,{CLEAR}你在工地的冲突中挺身而出,{CLEAR}着实让马志士馆主吃了一惊呢。{SCROLL}不够要得到马志士大人的认可,{NEWLINE}光靠这个可不行。{SCROLL}来吧,做好觉悟{NEWLINE}与马志士大人好好战斗一场吧！

Surge.{SCROLL}But that alone won’t earn you{NEWLINE}Lt. Surge’s approval.{SCROLL}Come on, steel yourself and give{NEWLINE}Lt. Surge a real battle!

strings.zh: 马志士馆主其实也不想{NEWLINE}让金婆婆在这里盖楼的,{CLEAR}但是金婆婆有那块地的所有权,{CLEAR}所以馆主他也拿金婆婆没办法。{SCROLL}强制停工30天{NEWLINE}已经是马志士馆主的最大权限了。{SCROLL}如今停工期限已到{NEWLINE}而联盟的禁令还没来,{CLEAR}所以焦急的市民们就开始坐不住了,{CLEAR}甚至有人指责馆主收了金婆婆的钱。{SCROLL}馆主为了防止我们沉不住气{NEWLINE}与市民发生冲突,{CLEAR}严令禁止我们离开道馆……{SCROLL}呜呜呜,马志士大人{NEWLINE}真是个坚强的男人啊！
strings.en: Lt. Surge never wanted Granny Kin to{NEWLINE}build here either.{SCROLL}But Granny Kin owns that land, so there{NEWLINE}was nothing he could do about her.{SCROLL}A 30-day forced work stoppage was the{NEWLINE}most he had the power to order.{SCROLL}Now the stoppage is over, and the{NEWLINE}League’s ban still hasn’t come.{SCROLL}The townsfolk are getting restless.{SCROLL}Some even accuse him of taking Granny{NEWLINE}Kin’s money.{SCROLL}To keep us from losing our cool and{NEWLINE}clashing with the townsfolk, he’s{CLEAR}flatly forbidden us to leave the Gym...{SCROLL}Sniff... Lt. Surge is such a tough man!
